rationale: With a 9–0 vote and the Chief Justice emphasizing a narrow, institution-preserving holding, Roberts is most likely to keep the opinion and frame it around the time-of-removal rule plus discretionary remand under § 1367(c). Separate writings are most likely from Justices inclined to sharpen the textual/jurisdictional distinction (Thomas, Gorsuch) or to stress anti-gamesmanship and limits on remand discretion (Alito).
